objective: Identify what operating economics, rather than a chosen multiple, must improve for an actionable Intel recommendation at the last verified November 6 close.
hurdle_status: Illustrative investor choices inherited from the current decision policy, not M37 requirements, a calculated cost of equity, or a definition of an objectively good investment.
reverse_margin: Add a CPU operating-margin improvement phased 25%,50%,75%,100% over2027-2030 and retained thereafter; preserve revenue, all other segment profits, capex, depreciation, working capital, taxes, leases, minority claims, credits and financing policies. This is a cost-efficiency-equivalent diagnostic. It assumes no incremental investment is required for the extra efficiency and is not a supported forecast.
cash_equivalent: Solve the extra normalized parent operating cash beginning2031 and growing3% thereafter needed to close the2030 equity-value gap. Keep2030 net assets, finite credits and financing bridge fixed. This is not a new forecast and cannot identify a unique market expectation.
terminal_bound: Set terminal net investment from2041 to zero while retaining3%growth, purely as an economically generous upper bound on the effect of changing terminal capital efficiency alone. Do not use this zero-reinvestment growth case as an investable forecast.

ablations.packaging_profit: Set only positive incremental new-packaging operating profit to zero; preserve2027 startup loss, all revenue, all physical capex, depreciation, working-capital investment, credits and ownership claims. This represents zero margin on delivered sales with stranded investment, not disappearance of the business or a free reduction in its capital cost.
ablations.Foundry: Use existing breakeven stress:2027 -4B,2028 -2.5B,2029 -1B,2030 onward0B; preserve all capital and product economics. This retains an improvement from current losses; it is not absence of a recovery.
ablations.joint: Recompute both operating-profit changes together, taxes and cash through2030, without adding precomputed scenario losses. All financing-access assumptions remain inherited and unverified.

no_fit_rule: No operating forecasts, main artifacts or recommendation are changed by these calculations. Do not interpret thresholds as likely outcomes, probabilities, organizer endorsement, or a short recommendation.
chronology: This policy is written before this script's first calculation, after existing forecasts, targets and prior thresholds are already known; it is not blinded.
